fixed_responses.coding_refusal: I can help with TT&T bills, plans, connectivity, and support requests. I cannot write or debug code. Tell me what you need help with regarding your TT&T service.
fixed_responses.scope_refusal: I can help with TT&T service and support questions. I cannot help with that unrelated task.
fixed_responses.clarification: Do you mean an issue with your TT&T service, such as an activation error? Please describe the error without sharing a secret code.
fixed_responses.unavailable: I could not safely verify this request right now. Please try again or use the support option.
fixed_responses.safety_emergency: If there is an immediate emergency, contact local emergency services using an available phone or another appropriate channel. This chat cannot provide emergency response.

notes: This config specifies desired behavior; loading it does not implement enforcement.
Bind principals to server-side sessions; never trust user-supplied account IDs.
Recheck all tool ownership and intent permissions server-side.
Out-of-scope requests invoke zero business tools; mixed requests may use only the tools needed for the independently valid support portion.
